_note: REVIEWED-style DRAFT for the INERT reference workflow (docs/architecture/n8n/N8N_CONTRACTS_DESIGN.md §6, §13). It is NOT in config/n8n_health_contracts.json and governs nothing at runtime: it shows the shape every contract takes under AGENTS.md §23.24, including the expected_output rule (operator 2026-10-15: a run that exits 0 but produces nothing is a FAILURE). Lane facts are copied from the REVIEWED contract aegis-nightly-ingestion in config/n8n_health_contracts.json and config/n8n_run_allowlist.json.

contract.target_reason: reference: shape only (stage shadow, dry_run; never imported)

purpose.text: Daily 19:00 ET: run the Aegis nightly delta (snapshot each tracked symbol into aegis_symbol_snapshot_nightly) as one fabric step through Run Lane.

connects_to.name: n8n -> relay 172.19.0.1:18092 -> gateway coordination/run + coordination/run_outcome -> tradeai-n8n-run-executor
/tmp/aegis_nightly_ingestion.lock(.dryrun)
connects_to.source: config/n8n_run_allowlist.json lock; executor uses <lock>.dryrun for dry runs

connects_to.name: data/runtime/aegis-nightly-ingestion_last.json
connects_to.source: LaneRunReceipt@v1 (P: @v2 output fields) at the allowlist output_signal

connects_to.name: n8n workflow tradeai-fabric-error -> relay POST /intent -> comms_intents

healthy.text: the Run Lane result is status success (RunOutcome@v1 via GET /run_outcome)
the lane receipt shows produced_count >= expected_output.min_produced and no fatal skip reason (LaneRunReceipt@v2, P)
a dry_run RunReceipt shows output_signal_mtime_after == output_signal_mtime_before

degraded.text: receipt ok_at older than 26.0 h but younger than 50.0 h
Run Lane needed more than one attempt, or a run ended skipped_lock

failed.text: Run Lane result failed (after its retry budget) or the outcome was lost
exit 0 but produced_count < min_produced, or a fatal skip reason (e.g. no_runner) — an empty success is a FAILURE
the receipt lacks produced_count while the rule is declared
a finished run left no RunReceipt (exit 0 is not evidence)
a dead letter was written or the lane's breaker opened (3 failures)
a dry_run changed its output_signal or any durable state

evidence.ref: Postgres aegis_symbol_snapshot_nightly rows with snapshot_date = the run's ET date

expected_output.applies_to: live runs; a dry run is checked for attempted_count >= 1 instead (it must write nothing)

baseline.freshness_rule: daily 0 19 * * * America/New_York; degraded = one slot missed + 2 h, failed = two slots missed + 2 h

alerting.routing: errorWorkflow tradeai-fabric-error -> POST /intent (fabric:workflow_error, DIGEST, runbook n8n-workflow-error) -> comms-intent consumer -> incident fan-in -> incident_notifier; never a direct send

verify: sqlite3 'file:$STATE_ROOT/data/governance/n8n_coordination_ledger.sqlite?mode=ro' "SELECT run_id, status, reason, duration_s FROM run_outcomes WHERE lane_id='aegis-nightly-ingestion' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 10"
evidence.never: an n8n execution status alone; the ledger outcome and the receipt's produced_count are the evidence

review.reviewed_by: reference shape (Agent A sub-agent); not an operator review
